title: Tool upgrades: wood, stone, iron, diamond

steps.title: Wood first
steps.say: A [wooden pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) is made from [planks](item:oak_planks) and [sticks](item:stick). It mines [stone](item:stone) and [coal ore](item:coal_ore), and breaks fast.

steps.title: Then stone
steps.say: Use [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) instead of [planks](item:oak_planks) for a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe). It mines [iron ore](item:iron_ore), [copper ore](item:copper_ore) and [lapis lazuli ore](item:lapis_ore).

steps.title: Then iron
steps.say: Smelt [raw iron](item:raw_iron) in a [furnace](item:furnace) to get [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot). An [iron pickaxe](item:iron_pickaxe) mines [diamond ore](item:diamond_ore), [gold ore](item:gold_ore), [redstone ore](item:redstone_ore) and [emerald ore](item:emerald_ore).

steps.title: Then diamond
steps.say: A [diamond pickaxe](item:diamond_pickaxe) takes 3 [diamonds](item:diamond) and 2 [sticks](item:stick). It is the only kind that mines [obsidian](item:obsidian) and [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris), besides netherite.

steps.title: Netherite is best
steps.say: At a [smithing table](item:smithing_table), add a [netherite ingot](item:netherite_ingot) and a [netherite upgrade template](item:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template) to a [diamond](item:diamond) tool. It turns into netherite.

steps.title: Fix your tools
steps.say: Put 2 worn tools of the same kind together in the crafting grid to make one fixed tool. An [anvil](item:anvil) fixes them and keeps their enchantments.
